about: The Keychain entry the iPhone app keeps its notification keys in, as src-tauri/src/phone_push.rs writes it and the notification extension reads it (PushNote.table). Both sides' tests read this file. The keys are RFC 8291 Appendix A's, which the server's fixture (crates/linger-server/tests/fixtures/push-notification.json) encrypts to; https://a.example has the wrong secret, so only https://linger.example opens that notification.
